name: Bedford
intro: Bedford is a town in Westchester County. Its Recreation and Parks Department runs senior adult meetings and programs with free local rides for shopping and meetings, a senior advocate for residents and their families, and lunch and Meals on Wheels through an agreement with the Village of Mount Kisco.

seniorCenter.name: Town of Bedford Senior Adults (Recreation and Parks)
seniorCenter.notes: Senior adults meet regularly for talks, crafts, exercise, movies, parties and special programs. Call the Seniors Line to join the mailing list for the bimonthly calendar. The town's senior advocate helps all Bedford residents, including family members who live outside the town, with aging-related resources, caregiver support groups and help for people with movement or vision difficulties. A senior nutrition program and home-delivered Meals on Wheels are offered through an agreement with the Village of Mount Kisco.

transport.name: Town of Bedford senior bus
transport.notes: Free rides from Recreation and Parks for local shopping and senior meetings. Call the Seniors Line for the schedule. Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses, for a $5 fare.

more.name: Town of Bedford Senior Advocate
more.note: Free help for Bedford residents and their immediate family members, including those who live outside the town, with aging-related resources, caregiver support groups and grant information.

more.name: Town of Bedford Recreation and Parks office
more.note: 425 Cherry Street, Bedford Hills. Open Monday to Friday, 8:30 am to 4:30 pm.

name: Briarcliff Manor
intro: Briarcliff Manor is a village in Westchester County. The Town of Ossining's senior center extends home-delivered lunches and discount taxi coupons to Briarcliff seniors, and the public library sits in Law Park on Library Road.

transport.name: Ossining Senior Center taxi coupons
transport.notes: Discount taxi coupons for Ossining and Briarcliff seniors 60 and older cost $3 each, up to 15 a month, with proof of age and residency. They can be used in and around Ossining, Briarcliff, the Croton ShopRite and Phelps Hospital only. Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses.

library.name: Briarcliff Manor Public Library
library.notes: Housed in a 2008 addition to a historic train station in Law Park. Open Monday to Wednesday, Friday and Saturday 10 am to 5 pm, Thursday 10 am to 7 pm, and closed Sunday.

sources: Westchester County DOT: ParaTransit Quick Reference

more.name: Ossining Senior Center home-delivered meals
more.note: The center at 95 Broadway, Ossining, delivers a hot lunch Monday to Friday to qualifying homebound seniors in Ossining and Briarcliff, for a $3.50 suggested contribution. Call for program guidelines.

name: Bronxville
intro: Bronxville is a village in the Town of Eastchester. Older residents can use Eastchester Senior Programs and Services, including medical rides and the senior center at Lake Isle, and the Bronxville Senior Citizens club meets twice a week at the Reformed Church on Pondfield Road.

seniorCenter.name: Bronxville Senior Citizens
seniorCenter.address: The Reformed Church of Bronxville, 180 Pondfield Road, Bronxville, NY 10708
seniorCenter.notes: A club for people 55 and older, run by the nonprofit Senior Citizens Council with support from the Town of Eastchester. It meets Tuesdays and Thursdays, September through July, and is closed in August. Membership is open to all who consider Bronxville their community; dues are $175 a year ($87.50 for members 90 and older). Programs include exercise, chair yoga, tai chi, line dancing, bridge, mah-jongg, canasta and talks; luncheons and day trips cost extra. Bronxville residents 60 and older can also use the Town of Eastchester's Center at Lake Isle (660 White Plains Road, 914-337-0390), which serves lunch daily and offers rides to residents of Eastchester, Tuckahoe and Bronxville. The county lists the lunch site as temporarily at the Tuckahoe Community Center, 71 Columbus Avenue, so call to confirm where lunch is served.

transport.name: Eastchester Senior Programs medical rides
transport.notes: Rides to medical appointments for residents 60 and older of Eastchester, Tuckahoe and Bronxville, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 2 pm, by reservation. A free escort gives light help when needed. Suggested round trip contributions are voluntary, at $5 within Eastchester, Tuckahoe, Bronxville and Scarsdale Village, $8 to Scarsdale, Mount Vernon, New Rochelle and Yonkers, and $10 to White Plains, Hartsdale and Harrison. The town also offers shopping and errand rides. Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses.

library.notes: The library lists resources for people with low vision.

name: Clarkstown
intro: Clarkstown is a town in Rockland County, with Town Hall at 10 Maple Avenue in New City. Its communities include New City, Nanuet, Congers, West Nyack and Bardonia. Older residents can join nine town senior clubs, ride the town Mini Trans bus at a reduced fare, and get lunch at the Meals on Wheels center in Nanuet.

seniorCenter.name: Clarkstown/Pearl River Senior Activity Center (Meals on Wheels Rockland)
seniorCenter.notes: Free to join for Rockland residents 60 and older. Open Monday to Friday, 10 am to 2 pm, and closed on holidays and bad weather days. Lunch is made daily, with kosher, therapeutic and mechanically altered choices. The suggested donation is $4 for lunch and $2 for a ride, and no one is refused service for not giving. Call or fill out the center's online form to join.

transport.name: Clarkstown Mini Trans
transport.notes: The town bus runs five routes that all meet at the Nanuet Mall. It runs Monday to Friday 6:55 am to 8:05 pm and Saturday 9 am to 7:10 pm, with no Sunday service. The senior and disabled fare is $0.40. It also gives weekday door-to-door rides to the Clarkstown senior clubs and rides from senior complexes to local supermarkets.

library.name: New City Library
library.address: 220 N. Main Street, New City, NY 10956
library.notes: One of several public libraries in the town. Nanuet and West Nyack have their own.

more.name: Clarkstown Senior Citizen Clubs
more.note: Nine town clubs for Clarkstown residents 55 and older meet weekly in Congers, Nanuet, New City and West Nyack. A free Senior ID card, good for five years, is needed to use town community centers, pools and the Stay Fit program. The phone is the town's main line.

more.name: Stay Fit Seniors (Clarkstown Parks and Recreation)
more.note: A 30-minute circuit wellness program for people 60 and older at the Street Community Center in New City. You must sign up ahead.

more.name: Town of Clarkstown Assessor
more.note: Call with questions about property tax exemptions for older homeowners.

more.name: TRIPS Paratransit (Rockland County)
more.note: County shared-ride bus for residents 60 and older who find the regular buses hard to use. For help applying, the county lists 845-364-2065.

places.name: Rockland Lake State Park
places.note: At 299 Rockland Lake Road in Valley Cottage. A 3.2-mile paved trail for walkers and cyclists circles the lake, and the park has picnic areas with tables. Open year round, daylight to dusk; a $10 vehicle fee is collected on spring and fall weekends and holidays and every day in summer.

name: Cortlandt
intro: Cortlandt is a town in northwestern Westchester County, on the Hudson River, that includes the villages of Buchanan and Croton-on-Hudson. The town's senior services, called The Cortlandt Golden Connection, run from the Muriel H. Morabito Community Center in Cortlandt Manor for town residents 60 and older, with lunch, a weekday bus and senior clubs.

seniorCenter.name: Muriel H. Morabito Community Center (The Cortlandt Golden Connection)
seniorCenter.notes: Programs and services are for Town of Cortlandt residents 60 and older. The county lists the center for congregate lunch and home-delivered meals. The Cortlandt, Nor-Cort and Crompond senior clubs meet here. To reserve lunch, call 914-528-5164 the day before by 11 am.

transport.name: Cortlandt senior bus to the Community Center
transport.notes: Runs Monday to Friday to the Morabito Community Center for lunch and senior programs, with morning pickup and afternoon return. The contribution is $3 round trip, and the bus needs at least 6 riders to run. Call the day before by 11 am; some restrictions apply. For other trips, Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses.

intro: Croton-on-Hudson is a village in the Town of Cortlandt. The village keeps a seniors contact at the Stanley H. Kellerhouse Municipal Building, and because most Croton residents also live in the Town of Cortlandt, they can use Cortlandt's senior lunch, home-delivered meals, rides and social worker at the Morabito Community Center.

Morabito Community Center and home-delivered, transportation and social worker consultations, 914-528-8377), Croton Caring (914-271-4979) for social programs, and the United Way 2-1-1 helpline.

transport.name: Cortlandt senior bus to the Community Center
transport.notes: For Town of Cortlandt residents 60 and older, which includes most Croton residents. Runs Monday to Friday to the Morabito Community Center for lunch and programs, $3 round trip, with at least 6 riders needed. Call the day before by 11 am. Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses.

library.notes: Open Monday 1 to 9 pm, Tuesday and Thursday 10 am to 9 pm, Wednesday and Friday 10 am to 5:30 pm, Saturday 10 am to 5 pm and Sunday 1 to 5 pm.

name: Dobbs Ferry
intro: Dobbs Ferry is a village in the Town of Greenburgh. Its Senior Citizen Program serves residents 60 and older at the Embassy Center on Palisade Street, with classes, a weekday lunch, a village senior bus and referral help.

seniorCenter.name: Embassy Community Center (Dobbs Ferry Senior Citizen Program)
seniorCenter.notes: Activities include tai chi, yoga, exercise, arts and crafts, bingo, bridge, mah-jongg, movies, computer lessons, drama readings, trips and monthly holiday luncheons. Lunch is served weekdays starting at 11 am, for a $3 suggested contribution. Call before 11 am at least one day ahead; there are no walk-ins for lunch. Homebound seniors can have lunch delivered by calling the same number. The village also lists 914-231-8566 for the nutrition program.

transport.name: Dobbs Ferry senior citizen bus
transport.notes: The village senior bus runs every weekday. Call before 9:30 am on the day you need a ride. Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses, for a $5 fare.

library.name: Dobbs Ferry Public Library
library.notes: Open Sunday 1 to 5 pm, Monday and Wednesday 10 am to 8 pm, Tuesday and Thursday 10 am to 6 pm, and Friday and Saturday 10 am to 5 pm.

name: Eastchester
intro: Eastchester is a town in Westchester County that includes the villages of Bronxville and Tuckahoe. Eastchester Senior Programs and Services serves adults 60 and older with medical and shopping rides, case management, long term care planning, home-delivered meals, small home repairs, Medicare counseling, and senior centers at Lake Isle and Garth Road.

seniorCenter.name: The Center at Lake Isle (Eastchester Senior Programs and Services)
seniorCenter.notes: The town's main senior center, at Lake Isle Country Club, offers wellness and exercise programs, trips and live performances, and lunch is served daily. Rides are available to residents of Eastchester, Tuckahoe and Bronxville; call for reservations. The county's club listing says the lunch site is temporarily at the Tuckahoe Community Center, 71 Columbus Avenue, so call to confirm where lunch is served. A neighborhood center at 235 Garth Road, Scarsdale, is open Wednesday and Friday afternoons (914-771-3340). For senior programs or the town social worker, call 914-771-3340.

transport.name: Eastchester Senior Programs medical rides
transport.notes: Rides to medical appointments for residents 60 and older of Eastchester, Tuckahoe and Bronxville, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 2 pm, by reservation. A free escort gives light help when needed. Suggested round trip contributions are voluntary, at $5 within Eastchester, Tuckahoe, Bronxville and Scarsdale Village, $8 to Scarsdale, Mount Vernon, New Rochelle and Yonkers, and $10 to White Plains, Hartsdale and Harrison. The town also offers shopping and errand rides. Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses.

name: Greenburgh
intro: Greenburgh is a town in Westchester County that includes the villages of Ardsley, Dobbs Ferry, Elmsford, Hastings-on-Hudson, Irvington and Tarrytown. Its Parks and Recreation Department runs the Gerard J. Byrne Center for seniors at Anthony F. Veteran Park, a weekday lunch program at three sites, home-delivered meals and senior transportation.

seniorCenter.name: Gerard J. Byrne Center at Anthony F. Veteran Park
seniorCenter.notes: An 8,000 square foot, fully accessible center with an exercise and dance room, resource center, lounge and activity rooms, open Monday to Friday, 9:30 am to 5 pm. Most classes cost $35, and day trips are offered. The town's lunch program for residents 60 and older runs Monday to Friday at the Embassy Community Center (60 Palisade Street, Dobbs Ferry), The Neighborhood House (43 Wildey Street, Tarrytown) and the Theodore D. Young Community Center (32 Manhattan Avenue, White Plains). The suggested contribution is $4, and no one is turned away. Call 914-989-1807 one business day ahead to reserve a meal.

transport.name: Greenburgh senior transportation
transport.notes: The town provides rides to its lunch sites when needed; call the nutrition program to arrange one. For other trips, Bee-Line ParaTransit (914-995-7272) serves people who cannot ride regular buses, for a $5 fare.

library.name: Greenburgh Public Library
library.notes: Open Monday to Wednesday 9:30 am to 8:30 pm, Thursday to Saturday 9:30 am to 5 pm and Sunday 1 to 5 pm. Several villages in the town have their own libraries.

more.name: Greenburgh Home Delivered Meals
more.note: A hot lunch delivered each weekday to residents 60 and older who are homebound by illness or disability or otherwise isolated. The suggested contribution is $4 a day.

more.name: Greenburgh Parks and Recreation registration office
more.note: Open Monday to Friday, 10 am to 4 pm, for program sign-ups.

name: Harrison
intro: Harrison is both a town and a village in Westchester County. Harrison Recreation sponsors two senior clubs, one downtown on Halstead Avenue and one in West Harrison on Underhill Avenue, plus a weekday drop-in center and monthly free blood pressure checks.

seniorCenter.name: Harrison Community Center (senior drop-in center)
seniorCenter.notes: The drop-in center is open Monday to Friday, 10 am to 4 pm, for TV, cards and socializing, with an exercise class Tuesdays from 10 to 11:30 am. The Downtown Group meets Fridays, noon to 3 pm, at the Veterans Memorial Building, 210 Halstead Avenue. The West Harrison Group meets Thursdays, noon to 3 pm, at the Leo Mintzer Community Center, 251 Underhill Avenue. Both clubs charge yearly dues and offer luncheons, day trips, movies and exercise and line dancing classes. A visiting nurse gives free blood pressure checks at both centers once a month, and county public health nurses give flu shots each October. Call for lunch, trip and ride details.

transport.name: Bee-Line ParaTransit (Westchester County)
transport.notes: County shared-ride, curb to curb service for people who cannot ride regular Bee-Line buses. It runs within 3/4 mile of a Bee-Line bus route, during the hours that route runs. The fare is $5 a trip, paid in exact cash or with a ticket, and a personal care attendant listed on the rider's ID card rides free. Book Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, up to 7 days ahead; next-day trips must be booked by 5 pm. You must apply and be found eligible first (press 3 on the phone line for an application).

library.notes: The West Harrison Branch is at 2 Madison Street (914-948-2092).

name: Hastings-on-Hudson
intro: Hastings-on-Hudson is a village in the Town of Greenburgh. Its Senior Outreach program at the James Harmon Community Center on Main Street gives free, private help to village residents 62 and older, from Medicare choices to housing and caregiver referrals, and posts monthly senior lunches and trips.

seniorCenter.name: Hastings-on-Hudson Senior Outreach (James Harmon Community Center)
seniorCenter.notes: Open Monday and Thursday 9 am to 3 pm and Tuesday 10 am to 3 pm, inside the Recreation Department office. Drop in or call for an appointment. Help includes telephone reassurance and home visits by appointment, Medicare plan selection, billing disputes, STAR and rent exemption questions, shopping and transportation referrals, home care referrals and caregiver support referrals.

Older residents have a Meals on Wheels senior center with lunch on Hudson Avenue, a town senior citizens club that runs trips, and the county TRIPS bus.

intro: Mount Kisco is both a town and a village in Westchester County. The Fox Senior Center on Carpenter Avenue is home to the Mount Kisco Senior Recreation Group and the Senior Nutrition Program, with a weekday lunch, curb to curb rides and wellness classes for seniors of Mount Kisco and nearby towns.

They can be used in and around the Town and Village of Ossining, Briarcliff, the Croton ShopRite and Phelps Hospital only.
